job: Add a quiet generated field of characters, dots or marks behind a hero, banner or empty state.
purpose: Fire's signature: letters and punctuation whose density follows a generated field, at very low contrast (under 1.6:1) and always decorative. A field fills its positioned parent behind the content. Fields are seeded by name so a page always looks the same, animate at 12 frames a second where they should, pause off-screen and stand still under reduced motion. Also holds dot grids, registration marks, grain and glyphs.
useWhen: A page hero, a launch banner or an empty state needs depth without adding anything to read.
A single object needs the page frame's registration marks.
An empty state needs a small accent glyph above its title.

avoidWhen.when: The decoration would sit behind paragraphs, tables, forms or code.
A status that shows live work.
The surface needs to say something, such as an announcement.
A chart or a data picture.
